exercises.prompt: Tell us about the last time you traveled by plane.
Some people prefer to travel alone, while others prefer to travel with friends or family. Which do you prefer, and why?
A university is considering requiring all students to study abroad for one semester before graduating. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your local airport is proposing a new runway. It would increase the number of flights but create more noise for nearby residents. I am a member of the airport board. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
